product_overview: Atlas is a multi-tenant learning and commerce backend that supports organizations, academies, courses, student learning, billing, websites, domains, provisioning, analytics, notifications, search, and platform administration. It enforces tenant isolation with PostgreSQL RLS and provides both public and authenticated APIs for managing the full academy lifecycle.
core_goals: Provide secure multi-tenant backend services with strong tenant isolation
Support academy and course management across organizations
Enable student learning flows including enrollment, progress, quizzes, and assignments
Handle billing, payment review, refunds, and course commerce workflows
Power academy websites, domains, media, provisioning, analytics, notifications, and search
Expose platform-owner controls for cross-tenant oversight, support, and audit logging

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Public liveness/readiness endpoint for monitoring service and infrastructure health.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 with database and Redis status -> Monitoring system records service as healthy
GET /health when database is unreachable -> Receive 503 or unhealthy status payload -> Monitoring system flags outage

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User registration, login, token refresh, logout, session validation, and password reset.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid name, email, and password -> Receive 201/200 registration response -> POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in with same credentials -> Receive 200 with access and refresh tokens
POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with normalized error payload -> No session is created
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with expired or revoked refresh token -> Receive 401 or 403 -> Client must reauthenticate

POST /api/v1/auth/password-reset/request with unknown email -> Receive 200 or safe generic response -> No account enumeration occurs -> POST /api/v1/auth/password-reset/confirm with invalid token -> Receive 400 or 401

features.name: User Profile
features.description: Authenticated users can view and manage their own profile, preferences, and password.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/users/me with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with current user profile -> PATCH /api/v1/users/me with updated name/avatar -> Receive 200 with updated profile
PATCH /api/v1/users/me/preferences with valid preferences -> Receive 200 with saved preferences -> GET /api/v1/users/me -> Receive profile containing updated preferences
POST /api/v1/users/me/password with incorrect current password -> Receive 400 or 403 -> Password remains unchanged

features.name: Organizations and Tenancy
features.description: Organization membership, tenant-scoped data access, and organization switching with strict isolation.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/organizations/:id with member JWT -> Receive 200 with organization details -> GET /api/v1/users/me -> Receive memberships including that organization
GET /api/v1/organizations/:id with JWT from non-member user -> Receive 403 or 404 -> Organization data is not disclosed
GET /api/v1/organizations with platform-owner JWT -> Receive 200 with cross-tenant organization list -> GET /api/v1/organizations/:id -> Receive 200 for any organization
GET /api/v1/organizations/:id with invalid or tampered id -> Receive 403 or 404 -> No cross-tenant leakage occurs

features.name: Academy Management
features.description: CRUD, membership, branding, stats, and activity operations for academies within an organization.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/academies with organization member credentials and organizationId -> Receive 201 with new academy -> GET /api/v1/academies/:id -> Receive academy details and membership
PATCH /api/v1/academies/:id with academy owner/administrator -> Receive 200 with updated academy -> GET /api/v1/academies/:id -> Confirm persisted changes
GET /api/v1/academies/:id/members with organization member -> Receive 200 with academy member list -> GET /api/v1/academies/:id/stats -> Receive academy statistics
PATCH /api/v1/academies/:id with non-member or non-manager credentials -> Receive 403 or 404 -> Academy is not modified

features.name: Subscription Plans and Entitlements
features.description: Plan catalog, add-on catalog, trial policy, and organization usage/entitlement reporting.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/plans -> Receive 200 with plan catalog -> GET /api/v1/plans/:key -> Receive 200 with plan details
GET /api/v1/add-ons -> Receive 200 with add-on catalog -> GET /api/v1/add-ons/:key -> Receive 200 with add-on details
GET /api/v1/organizations/:id/subscription -> Receive 200 with current subscription -> GET /api/v1/organizations/:id/usage -> Receive usage metrics with computed limits
PATCH /api/v1/trial-policy with non-platform-owner -> Receive 403 -> PATCH /api/v1/trial-policy with platform-owner -> Receive 200 with updated trial policy

features.name: Course Management
features.description: Academy-scoped course authoring including categories, sections, lessons, publishing, and ordering.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/academies/:id/courses with academy member credentials -> Receive 200 with course list -> POST /api/v1/academies/:id/courses with valid payload -> Receive 201 with created course
PATCH /api/v1/academies/:id/courses/:courseId -> Receive 200 with updated course -> POST /api/v1/academies/:id/courses/:courseId/publish -> Receive 200 with published course

PATCH /api/v1/academies/:id/courses/:courseId/sections/order with exact section permutation -> Receive 200 with reordered sections -> PATCH /api/v1/academies/:id/courses/:courseId/sections/:sectionId -> Receive 200 with edited section
DELETE /api/v1/academies/:id/courses/:courseId with archive-capable workflow -> Receive 200/204 or archived status transition -> GET /api/v1/academies/:id/courses/:courseId -> Confirm final state

features.name: Course Discovery and Learning
features.description: Student-facing published course discovery, enrollment, progress, quizzes, and assignments.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/courses with student JWT -> Receive 200 with published public courses -> GET /api/v1/courses/:id -> Receive 200 with course details

POST /api/v1/enrollments for a free published course -> Receive 201 or 200 with enrollment -> GET /api/v1/enrollments -> See new enrollment -> GET /api/v1/courses/:id/progress -> Receive initial progress state
POST /api/v1/courses/:id/progress/complete-lesson with enrolled student -> Receive 200 -> GET /api/v1/courses/:id/progress -> Receive updated completion progress
POST /api/v1/courses/:id/quizzes/:quizId/attempts with valid answers -> Receive 201 or 200 -> POST /api/v1/courses/:id/quizzes/:quizId/attempts/:attemptId/submit -> Receive graded result
POST /api/v1/courses/:id/assignments/:assignmentId/submission with text or attachment -> Receive 201 or 200 -> GET /api/v1/courses/:id/assignments/:assignmentId/submission -> Receive saved submission

features.name: Instructor Operations
features.description: Instructor-facing views for dashboard, rosters, grading, and assessment review.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/instructor/dashboard with teaching-scope instructor -> Receive 200 with dashboard metrics -> GET /api/v1/instructor/courses -> Receive 200 with assigned courses
GET /api/v1/instructor/courses/:id/students -> Receive 200 with course roster -> GET /api/v1/instructor/courses/:id/students/:studentId -> Receive 200 with student details

GET /api/v1/instructor/courses/:id/assignments/:assignmentId/submissions -> Receive 200 with submissions -> POST /api/v1/instructor/courses/:id/assignments/:assignmentId/submissions/:submissionId/grade -> Receive 200 with persisted grade
POST /api/v1/instructor/courses/:id/assignments/:assignmentId/submissions/:submissionId/grade with non-instructor -> Receive 404 or 403 -> Submission is not graded

features.name: Community Announcements, Blog, and Forums
features.description: Course-scoped announcements, academy blog posts, and discussion forums for community engagement.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/courses/:courseId/announcements with enrolled user -> Receive 200 with visible announcements -> POST /api/v1/courses/:courseId/announcements with academy owner/administrator -> Receive 201 with draft or published announcement

GET /api/v1/blog-posts -> Receive 200 with visible blog posts -> POST /api/v1/blog-posts with author credentials -> Receive 201 with new post -> POST /api/v1/blog-posts/:id/publish -> Receive 200 with published post

GET /api/v1/courses/:id/forum/threads -> Receive 200 with thread list -> POST /api/v1/courses/:id/forum/threads -> Receive 201 with new thread -> POST /api/v1/courses/:id/forum/threads/:threadId/replies -> Receive 201 with reply

POST /api/v1/courses/:id/forum/threads/:threadId/lock with instructor or owner/administrator -> Receive 200 -> POST /api/v1/courses/:id/forum/threads/:threadId/replies by regular student -> Receive 403

features.name: Media Library
features.description: Academy media uploads and asset management backed by object storage.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/academies/:id/media with academy staff -> Receive 200 with asset list -> POST /api/v1/academies/:id/media with valid file -> Receive 201 with stored asset metadata
PATCH /api/v1/academies/:id/media/:assetId -> Receive 200 with updated metadata -> POST /api/v1/academies/:id/media/:assetId/archive -> Receive 200 with archived asset status
POST /api/v1/academies/:id/media with invalid MIME or oversized file -> Receive 400 or 413 -> Asset is not stored

features.name: Website Builder
features.description: Manage academy website draft configuration, pages, sections, publishing, and content validation.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/academies/:id/website/configuration -> Receive 200 with draft configuration -> PATCH /api/v1/academies/:id/website/configuration with partial updates -> Receive 200 with merged configuration
GET /api/v1/academies/:id/website/pages -> Receive 200 with page list -> POST /api/v1/academies/:id/website/pages with custom page data -> Receive 201 with new page

PATCH /api/v1/academies/:id/website/pages/:pageId/sections/reorder with valid order -> Receive 200 with reordered sections -> DELETE /api/v1/academies/:id/website/pages/:pageId for custom page -> Receive 200/204
POST /api/v1/academies/:id/website/publish -> Receive 200 with published website state -> GET /api/v1/academies/:id/website/pages/:pageId -> Receive published page data

features.name: CMS Content Library and SEO
features.description: Localized FAQ/testimonial content management plus SEO resolution and structured-data utilities.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/academies/:id/website/faq-entries -> Receive 200 with FAQ entries -> POST /api/v1/academies/:id/website/faq-entries with localized content -> Receive 201 with new entry
PATCH /api/v1/academies/:id/website/faq-entries/:entryId -> Receive 200 with updated FAQ -> POST /api/v1/academies/:id/website/faq-entries/:entryId/publish -> Receive 200 with published status

GET /api/v1/academies/:id/website/testimonial-entries -> Receive 200 with testimonial entries -> POST /api/v1/academies/:id/website/testimonial-entries -> Receive 201 with created testimonial -> POST /api/v1/academies/:id/website/testimonial-entries/:entryId/archive -> Receive 200 with archived testimonial

resolvePageSeo / resolveCourseSeo utility execution on existing website and course data -> Return resolved meta fields and structured data objects -> Public website renderer consumes the computed SEO payload

features.name: Public Website Runtime
features.description: Unauthenticated public website resolution for academy websites, pages, SEO, and hostname mapping.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/public/websites/resolve with trusted hostname -> Receive 200 with academy resolution -> GET /api/v1/public/websites/:academyId -> Receive 200 with published website
GET /api/v1/public/websites/:academyId/pages -> Receive 200 with published visible page list -> GET /api/v1/public/websites/:academyId/pages/:slug -> Receive 200 with published page content
GET /api/v1/public/websites/:academyId/pages/:slug for draft or hidden page -> Receive 404 -> No draft content is leaked
GET /api/v1/public/websites/resolve with unknown or malicious hostname -> Receive 404 or safe failure -> No cross-tenant data is revealed

features.name: Domains and Infrastructure
features.description: Academy custom domains, platform domain settings, hostname verification, and Cloudflare-backed infrastructure status.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/academies/:id/website/domain -> Receive 200 with current domain state -> POST /api/v1/academies/:id/website/domain/custom-domain with valid hostname -> Receive 201 or 200 with pending verification

POST /api/v1/academies/:id/website/domain/verify -> Receive 200 with verification result or pending status -> DELETE /api/v1/academies/:id/website/domain/custom-domain -> Receive 200 with cleared custom domain
GET /api/v1/platform-domain -> Receive 200 with platform domain configuration -> PATCH /api/v1/platform-domain with platform-owner -> Receive 200 with updated base domain
GET /api/v1/infrastructure/:provider/status -> Receive 200 with provider status payload -> Service reports honest not-configured or failed state when credentials are absent

features.name: Atlas Subscription Billing
features.description: Organization billing for Atlas plans and add-ons, including checkout, manual payment review, invoices, and webhooks.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/organizations/:id/checkouts with idempotency key and plan selection -> Receive 201 with checkout -> GET /api/v1/organizations/:id/checkouts/:checkoutId -> Receive 200 with checkout snapshot
GET /api/v1/payment-methods -> Receive 200 with available payment methods -> POST /api/v1/organizations/:id/payments with payment method -> Receive 201 with pending payment

PATCH /api/v1/organizations/:id/payments/:paymentId/proof with uploaded proof -> Receive 200 and review status pending -> GET /api/v1/organizations/:id/payments/:paymentId/proof/file -> Receive authorized proof file access

POST /api/v1/payments/:id/approve with platform-owner and reviewer privileges -> Receive 200 with succeeded payment and updated subscription -> POST /api/v1/payments/:id/reject -> Receive 200 with failed payment and unchanged subscription
POST /api/v1/payments/webhook with invalid signature -> Receive 401 or 403 -> Event is rejected and not applied

features.name: Organization Payment Settings
features.description: Organization-level payment collection mode, provider credentials, and commission-related configuration.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/organizations/:id/payment-settings -> Receive 200 with payment mode state -> PATCH /api/v1/organizations/:id/payment-settings -> Receive 200 with updated mode

GET /api/v1/organizations/:id/payment-settings/gateway-providers -> Receive 200 with selectable provider list -> PUT /api/v1/organizations/:id/payment-settings/gateway-credentials with encrypted config -> Receive 200 with saved credentials

POST /api/v1/organizations/:id/payment-settings/gateway-credentials/test-connection -> Receive 200 or 4xx with test result -> POST /api/v1/organizations/:id/payment-settings/gateway-credentials/enable -> Receive 200 when verified

POST /api/v1/organizations/:id/payment-settings/gateway-credentials/disable -> Receive 200 with disabled status -> GET /api/v1/organizations/:id/payment-settings/commission -> Receive 200 with effective commission details

features.name: Course Commerce
features.description: Student course purchasing, payment application, commission snapshots, refunds, and academy payouts.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/courses/:id/course-orders with valid student and course -> Receive 201 with draft course order -> POST /api/v1/course-orders/:orderId/payments -> Receive 201 with pending payment

PATCH /api/v1/course-orders/:id/payments/:paymentId/proof with proof upload -> Receive 200 with pending manual review -> POST /api/v1/platform-course-order-payments/:id/approve -> Receive 200 with succeeded payment, paid order, enrollment creation, and ledger entries
POST /api/v1/course-orders/:id/refund within refund window -> Receive 200 with refunded order and unavailable enrollment -> GET /api/v1/course-orders/:id/refund -> Receive 200 with refund record
GET /api/v1/academies/:id/payouts -> Receive 200 with payout records -> GET /api/v1/academies/:id/payouts/revenue-summary -> Receive 200 with revenue summary
POST /api/v1/course-orders/:id/payments in organization_gateway mode with no real gateway adapter -> Receive 409 gateway not configured -> No payment is created

features.name: Provisioning Orchestration
features.description: Resumable seven-step provisioning requests for academy creation, subdomain allocation, domain connection, and completion.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/organizations/:id/provisioning-requests with requested academy and subdomain -> Receive 201 with request and step list -> GET /api/v1/organizations/:id/provisioning-requests/:requestId -> Receive 200 with current step state

POST /api/v1/organizations/:id/provisioning-requests/:requestId/retry after a failed step -> Receive 200 and resumed execution -> GET /api/v1/organizations/:id/provisioning-requests -> Receive updated status list
POST /api/v1/organizations/:id/provisioning-requests/:requestId/cancel -> Receive 200 with cancelled request -> Subsequent retry attempt -> Receive 409 because request is terminal
GET /api/v1/subdomains/availability with requested label -> Receive 200 with available or taken response -> Provisioning UI uses result before creating request

features.name: Platform Owner Control Plane
features.description: Cross-tenant administrative read access, support operations, audit logs, and platform settings.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/organizations as platform owner -> Receive 200 with all organizations -> GET /api/v1/platform-academies -> Receive 200 with all academies
GET /api/v1/platform-users -> Receive 200 with user directory -> GET /api/v1/audit-log -> Receive 200 with ordered audit entries
GET /api/v1/support-cases -> Receive 200 with support case list -> PATCH /api/v1/support-cases/:id/status -> Receive 200 with updated case status
GET /api/v1/platform-settings -> Receive 200 with platform settings -> PATCH /api/v1/platform-settings with platform-owner -> Receive 200 with saved changes
Attempt support or audit access as non-platform-owner -> Receive 403 -> No cross-tenant administrative data is revealed

features.name: Platform Analytics
features.description: Platform-wide metrics and analytics over organizations, academies, courses, payments, revenue, and usage.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/platform-metrics with platform-owner -> Receive 200 with seven KPI snapshot -> Dashboard renders trend values
GET /api/v1/analytics/overview with date range -> Receive 200 with aggregate users, active users, engagement, and revenue -> GET /api/v1/analytics/time-series/revenue -> Receive 200 with daily series
GET /api/v1/analytics/breakdown/plan -> Receive 200 with plan-based breakdown -> Analytics tab renders grouped data
GET /api/v1/platform-metrics or /api/v1/analytics/* with non-platform-owner -> Receive 403 -> Cross-tenant analytics remain hidden

features.name: Notifications
features.description: In-app notification feed, notification preferences, and read-state management.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/notifications -> Receive 200 with current user's notifications -> GET /api/v1/notifications/summary -> Receive 200 with unread counts
GET /api/v1/notifications/preferences -> Receive 200 with preferences -> PATCH /api/v1/notifications/preferences -> Receive 200 with updated delivery settings
PATCH /api/v1/notifications/:id/read -> Receive 200 with read state updated -> POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all -> Receive 200 and all notifications marked read
GET /api/v1/notifications as another user or unauthenticated -> Receive 401/403 -> Notification data remains private

features.name: Global Search
features.description: Server-side permission-scoped search across users, organizations, academies, courses, and system pages.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/search?q=academy as platform owner -> Receive 200 with users, platform, content, and system results
GET /api/v1/search?q=academy as regular tenant member -> Receive 200 with tenant-allowed content only -> Platform-only user results are excluded
GET /api/v1/search?q=academy&unexpected=foo -> Receive 400 due to validation -> Search does not execute with unrecognized parameters
GET /api/v1/search?q=public-course -> Receive only permitted published content results -> Private or cross-tenant rows are filtered server-side

tech_stack: PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM 5 with Row-Level Security (RLS) multi-tenancy
JWT (@nestjs/jwt) access/refresh token authentication with Argon2 password hashing
Cloudflare R2 / S3-compatible object storage (AWS SDK v3, MinIO locally) for media

known_limitations.issue: No global request-body size limit configuration observed at the app bootstrap level beyond Nest/Express defaults.
known_limitations.impact: Large payload DoS risk should be validated separately (not covered by functional API tests).

known_limitations.issue: Payment webhook endpoints are intentionally unauthenticated and rely solely on provider signature verification.
known_limitations.impact: Test plan must verify signature validation rejects tampered/missing-signature payloads.

known_limitations.issue: Public website and health endpoints are unauthenticated by design.
known_limitations.impact: These should be excluded from auth-required negative tests.
